title: ISO 19650-governed megaprojects and their audited outcomes
description:
The largest capital projects with a documented ISO 19650 or predecessor (PAS 1192) information-management mandate: 11 records across five jurisdictions and four sectors, with original and final budgets, overrun, schedule slip and the primary source for each record.

Overruns are recorded, not attributed. None of these audits isolates the contribution of the information-management mandate to the outcome. The finding is the absence of an independently audited success, not proof of causation.

Full methodology and discussion: The Dark Side of BIM: The Biggest ISO 19650 Failures.
